memories.title: Preserve the compiler cache on targeted rebuilds
memories.summary: After a compiler configuration change, keep the cache and run the smallest targeted rebuild before a full build.
memories.body: For a compiler-only change, preserve the existing cache and run the smallest affected target first. Escalate to a full rebuild only when the targeted result is invalid.

memories.title: Normalize macOS private path aliases
memories.summary: Treat the public var alias and private-var target as the same canonical macOS location before comparing workspace paths.
memories.body: Resolve the known macOS system alias before comparing paths. Keep user-provided workspace roots within the resolved root and reject unrelated symbolic links.

memories.title: Keep session data scoped to the active workspace
memories.summary: Use the active workspace identity for session and task state so switching tabs cannot read another project.
memories.body: Resolve project state from the active workspace root and include that root in cache identity. Reset subscriptions when the active workspace changes.

memories.title: Use an absolute executable path for hooks
memories.summary: Resolve the installed plugin executable before writing a hook so a desktop process with a reduced PATH can invoke it.
memories.body: Prefer the stable installed executable path and reject transient build paths. Verify availability before writing the project hook configuration.

memories.title: Separate input and output token accounting
memories.summary: Record prompt, completion, acquisition, and retrieval costs separately so memory overhead can be measured.
memories.body: Keep input and output usage separate and record acquisition and retrieval overhead independently. Do not infer a quality gain from a token count alone.

memories.title: Do not reuse stale workspace state
memories.summary: A cached workspace identity from a previous tab must not be used after the active workspace changes.
memories.body: When the active workspace changes, invalidate the previous subscription and require a fresh workspace identity before reading state.

memories.title: Avoid unverified hook commands
memories.summary: An unverified command source must not be promoted into an active hook configuration.
memories.body: Keep an unverified hook suggestion out of active configuration until its source and executable identity have been checked.
